hooks.name: Deny formulary write (shell)
hooks.description: Blocks shell commands that touch afterglow-formulary/validated/** unless they are a single read-only command with no redirection or chaining.

action.command: in=$(cat); c=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.. | .command? // empty' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$c" ] || c="$in"; if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq 'afterglow-formulary/+validated([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)'; then if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*(ls|cat|grep|rg|wc|head|tail|git +(status|log|diff|show))[[:space:]][^>;&|`$]*$'; then exit 0; fi; echo 'deny-formulary-write-shell: the validated formulary is written only by the review pipeline. Single read-only commands are fine; writes, redirects and chains are denied.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
